future_reservation.detail: A label-free survey of competitions.json at pinned revision b0bc9f22 (2026-05-26) found no complete men's tournament after Euro 2024. Per PLAN.md M5 item 5, further model-selection claims therefore freeze after M7 unless a future pinned source revision adds a genuinely untouched complete tournament. Recycling AFCON 2023 or Copa America 2024 after qualification is prohibited.

rules: No development or tuning loader may read a sealed set's rows or labels before M7 opens its one-time qualification run.
Only target-free structural validation is permitted before opening: file existence, schema compatibility, match identifiers, coordinate bounds and parser success.
Outcome-bearing facts (shot outcomes, goal counts, conversion rates, model scores, row-level previews) must never appear in any sealed-set report or log.
A sealed set opened for M7 qualification may never be reused for further selection; recycling after a failed gate is prohibited.
